label: Boards
summary: Brainstorm's creative space: infinite whiteboards and moodboards to sketch, collect and group images, notes, links, to-dos and columns, with comments, @ mentions and live editing together. Replaces Brainstorm's old Board and brings its cards across, and keeps Brainstorm's maps (all goals, grouped notes) as boards under From Brainstorm.

realtime: private channels 'board:<id>' (policies on realtime.messages; per board since 0.13.0)

access.sharing: per board (0.13.0): an owner; everyone with Boards can edit, view or not see it; named people can edit or view; view-only links read through board-view. Enforced by venia_board_role in RLS.

ownModuleData: venia_module_data row 'brainstorm', key 'board' (the old Board, read to bring its cards across; never written)

venia_module_data row 'brainstorm', keys 'dump' and 'dumpMap' (goals, steps, loose notes and Enigma's grouping, read to add them to the From Brainstorm boards b-brainstorm-goals and b-brainstorm-groups; never written)
otherModules: product (only while Product is on): styles and photos handed over by VENIA OS through sessionStorage 'boards:import'; Boards never reads Product's data itself
sales (only while Sales, Product and Boards are on): a line sheet handed over the same way, made into slides; Boards keeps no Sales data beyond what is drawn on the board

toHost.boards:title: {title}
toHost.boards:open-style: {styleId} — open that style in the line list (Product on only)
toHost.boards:style-info: {ids} — ask for the current name, colourway, price and stage of linked style cards
toHost.boards:session: ask for the site's sign-in when Boards can't find one (Build 652)
toHost.boards:link: {req} — are Product and Boards both on? (Build 657)
toHost.boards:catalog: {req, kind: styles|materials} — a plain list to pick from in Add from VENIA (Product on only)
toHost.boards:material-info: {req, ids} — the current words of linked material cards
toHost.boards:create-style: {req, name, notes, image|source, board} — make a NEW draft style in Product from a photo and notes
toHost.boards:save-material: {req, name, notes, image|source, board} — make a NEW draft material (or link to one with the same name, unchanged)
toHost.boards:linesheet-board: {key, boardId, title} — a line sheet was made into this board; Sales keeps the link to open it again (Build 658)

fromHost.boards:create-style: {req, ok, id, name, code, photo} or {ok:false, message}
fromHost.boards:save-material: {req, ok, id, name, existing?, photo} or {ok:false, message}
fromHost.boards:signed-in: the site signed in or out: look again
fromHost.#/import: opens the Add to a board sheet for what the shell left in sessionStorage boards:import {source, title, items:[{styleId?, name, image, colors, retail, status, category, delivery}]}. A line sheet (Build 658) adds {layout:'linesheet', sheet:{key, name, season, currency, delivery, frozen, perPage, cols}, linkedDefault} and items carry code, sizes and wholesale: each page lands as an A4 landscape slide

host.today: Today shows your unseen rows in venia_board_mentions under 'Mentioned on Boards'; opening one calls veniaOpenBoards(boardId, commentId), i.e. /boards#/b/<id>/c/<commentId>

accepts: style, photo, material (from Product) onto a board
line sheet (from Sales) as A4 landscape slides (Build 658)
